title: Purely cosmetic surgery on knots in the three-sphere
main_claim: Theorem 1.1: if K is a nontrivial knot in S^3, then S^3_r(K) and S^3_s(K) are orientation-preservingly homeomorphic only when r = s. Prior work (Hanselman, Daemi–Lidman–Miller Eismeier) reduces this to the case of slopes ±2 on a genus-two knot. The paper rules that case out with an SO(3)/PU(2)-monopole cobordism on a closed parameterized stack built using the cosmetic diffeomorphism phi. The instanton links give 2^eta·Omega with Omega ≠ 0, the lens-face ends cancel in pairs, and Stokes' theorem then forces 2^eta·Omega = 0.

issues.location: sections/02-ordinary.tex, Theorem thm:ordinary:units (i), step Y_1 -> Y_2
issues.description: The claim that the rigid map Y_1 -> Y_2 is a unit mod 2 rests on an exact-triangle-type pentagon argument for the irreducible-only complex at an end that has central reducibles (H_1(Y_2) = Z/2). This is not Floer's classical homology-sphere triangle. The paper supplies its own central-contact exclusion for it, which I did not verify in full. A sanity check on the trefoil is consistent with the claim: on that check, Y_{±1} and Y_{±2} each have 2 irreducible SU(2) representations. This is a point I did not verify, not an identified error.
issues.evidence: "Each rigid meridional handle map Y_r -> Y_{r+1}, for r=0,1, is a unit whenever its determinant has the specified end restrictions."

coverage:
Read in full: the introduction, the section 2 setup and lattice lemmas, the section 3 statement and the minimal-cap lemma, all of section 5 (lattice, lifts, telescope, local excess, composition, finite-lattice lemma, nonzero theorem), the section 7 clamp statement, section 8 lines 1-440 (closed indices, lens index table, lens charge, virtual sums), and the final contradiction theorem in section 10.

Computations checked by hand:
- Section 2 compressed-pentagon chain, radical and determinant evaluations.
- The positive-cell polygon: the fan determinants, the chain [-1,-2,-2,-2,-1], and U^2 = 0.
- Q_P, F_r, F'_l, F_0, and the c_0 and Lambda_0 evaluations; the characteristic congruence; the dual-square formulas.
- The bit-change Lambda^2 and Theta telescope, and the n_D growth formula (5m-n)/8.
- The degree congruence (n + 3m divisible by 8).
- The vertex values lambda_I.
- The Dirac index table via chi(F_4, O(aT)) and the weighted P(1,1,4) Euler characteristics.
- The ASD normal differences 0, 1, 4 and the lens corrections delta_I and delta_sp.
- The choice of reference filling at the '-' state.
- The virtual sums Sum(q_i + 4) = 4 and Sum i_i - 2 eta = 2 - 4k.
- The 2^eta link multiplicity.

The finite-lattice mod-2^N repetition argument (Nakayama, then odd determinant, then the exponent of GL_r(Z/2^N)) is correct. Nontriviality of K enters through Gabai's foliation and the caps, so the argument does not wrongly rule out the unknot, where ±2 surgery really is cosmetic.

Not verified line by line: the analytic compactness, regularization, finite equivariant branch perturbations and gluing (sections 6, 9, 10, about 4000 lines), the body of the Abelian clamp proof (section 7), the sections 3 and 4 unit and cap-pairing proofs, and the sign comparison for the lens-face cancellation. A verdict on the full analytic part is therefore out of reach at this depth.
